For \(x>1\), repeatedly applying \(f(x)=f(x-2)\) gives roots when the reduced argument is \(-1\) or \(1\). Thus the positive roots are all odd positive integers:
\[
a_n=1,3,5,\ldots \quad \Rightarrow \quad a_n=2n-1.
\]
So the sum is
\[
\sum_{n=1}^{2017} (-1)^{n+1}(2n-1)
= (1-3)+(5-7)+\cdots+(4029-4031)+4033.
\]
There are \(1008\) pairs, each summing to \(-2\), so the sum is
\[
1008(-2)+4033=-2016+4033=2017.
\]
\[
\boxed{2017}
\]
